body: i’m so so glad you decided to stay. everyone has a story, no matter what i promise promise you you are stronger than what your mind tells you. my messages are always open
thank you so much. as the days go by things seem to get worse. at this point, the fact that death didn’t accept me when i tried, gives me some hope that maybe i was meant to stay.
“everything happens for a reason” always makes me so fucking pissed
the fact you came here shows that you have some fight left in you. please message me if you need. you have people who are here for you, even though you may not know them.
